name: Shizumine Ryuuji
source:
"If Meguri says so, then it's fine."

The protagonist. Has stiff and calm personality. Speaks few words, and not really good at expressioning his emotion.

Currently living alone in a big house. He lost his mother and older brother, his father also not living with him.
